# `csharp_wrap_chained_binary_expressions`

Break each operand of a long && or || chain onto its own line. wrap_if_long packs operands instead of breaking every one. Only honoured in deterministic mode (max_line_length set).

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `chop_if_long` |  |
| `wrap_if_long` |  |

**Default:** `(not set)`

### `csharp_wrap_chained_binary_expressions = chop_if_long`

```ini
csharp_wrap_chained_binary_expressions = chop_if_long
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public bool Check(int a, int b, int c)
    {
        return a > 0 && b > 0 && c > 0 && a + b > c && a + c > b && b + c > a;
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public bool Check(int a, int b, int c)
    {
        return a > 0 && b > 0 && c > 0 && a + b > c && a + c > b && b + c > a;
    }
}
```
:::

::::
